notes: The update notice now says something you can act on wherever you are running it. It offered the Windows installer to everybody, including anyone on a Mac or on Linux, where a .cmd is an instruction that cannot be followed. Windows gets the direct download; everywhere else gets a short link to the releases page, and the radio works out which without being told. Both readmes and the Service pane say it the same way. A station name that only just fitted its box could scroll anyway: letter-spacing is applied after the last character too, and that final gap draws nothing while still counting as overflow. On the departures board, where names move a whole flap at a time, a name with visible room to its right lurched a full cell and back for ever. Names are measured by their ink now. The broadcast console meter has a peak lamp: one segment held lit at the loudest thing it has seen, up instantly, held for a second and a half, then let down. Its bar is snapped to whole segments to match. And the button that closes Settings turns green when there is something to save, so the word is not the only thing that changed.
